answer: Sybil resistance requires each agent to prove possession of a hardware-backed enclave key, while remote attestation verifies its approved MRENCLAVE; copying a VM alone cannot produce that proof. Enrollment must bind identities to non-exportable, platform-specific credentials and limit each credential to one identity, so scaling identities requires additional attested hardware rather than duplicated images. Names such as nadir, falcon, and nectar confer no trust by themselves.
